card1_example: CTOs whose Scala or AI system is breaking and who need a specialist this quarter
card1_body: An enterprise doesn't switch engineering partners because an ad caught a CTO mid-scroll. They switch when a system breaks and they search for a fix. These channels also need huge audiences, and 'CTOs evaluating Scala partners right now' is too small a slice to target.
card4_body: The only channel that scores green on the requirement that matters most: it puts Fusionpact in front of an engineering leader the moment they search for the fix.
